import glob,sys
ports=glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbmodem*')
if len(ports)!=1:
    print('Expected exactly one C6 usbmodem candidate, got: '+repr(ports), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
print(ports[0])
PY
); case "$PORT" in /dev/cu.usbmodem*) ;; *) echo 'Refusing non-C6 serial candidate' >&2; exit 3;; esac; test "$PORT" != '/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'; echo "SONOFF_DIAG_C6_PORT=$PORT"; PORT="$PORT" python3 - <<'PY' | tee /tmp/c6_sonoff_repair.log
import os,serial,time
port=os.environ['PORT']
s=serial.Serial()
s.port=port
s.baudrate=115200
s.timeout=0.20
s.write_timeout=1
s.dtr=False
s.rts=False
s.open()
start=time.monotonic(); end=start+330.0; sent=False
try:
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        if not sent and elapsed>=1.0:
            s.write(b'permit 255\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: permit 255', flush=True); sent=True
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            print(data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(), flush=True)
finally:
    s.close()
PY
LOG=/tmp/c6_sonoff_repair.log; echo '=== SONOFF RELEVANT EVENTS ==='; grep -E 'permit join|ZIGBEE_DEVICE_|descriptor |basic |binding |reporting |input (available|unavailable) zigbee|measurement zigbee|check-in|discovery|queue full|failed after retries|lock timeout|route superseded' "$LOG" || true; echo '=== SONOFF DIAG COUNTS ==='; printf 'announce=%s rejoin=%s update=%s descriptor=%s binding=%s reporting=%s zigbee_measurement=%s checkin=%s\n' "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_ANNOUNCE' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_REJOIN' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_UPDATE' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'descriptor ' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'binding ' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'reporting ' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'measurement zigbee/' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_CHECK_IN' "$LOG" || true)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
